newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES END STEADY IN ILLIQUID MARKET.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES END STEADY IN ILLIQUID MARKET.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates finished at 23.125 percent on Monday, unchanged from Friday, traders said, adding they did not expect a downward movement over the next few days.
"Overnight rates would probably hover around this level for the next few days. If they move at all, that would only be a slight rise," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
However, today traders saw higher activity than in the second half of last week.
"Tight liquidity has kept overnight rates relatively high, but there were more deals today than on Friday," Kalman said.
With most markets players anticipating an imminent repo rate cut by the central bank, the reverse repo facility soaks up most of the available money.
